design.decision: Count likely ruffs into the bid and bid up when short in a side suit.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first trump win; opponents pull trumps against big contracts.
design.rationale: A bid-tension version of the trump payoff; it departs from the plain template by combining scaling and a trigger, which the bid-tension target justifies.
design.draftText: +4 contract points for each trick in your team's contract when your team wins a trick by trumping

critic.concerns: Trump-win count times contract is a two-quantity product; overlaps seed-trump-points with a scaling departure.
